policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="model" value="@{
        try {
            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            return (string)body["model"] ?? "";
        } catch (Exception) {
            return "";
        }
    }" />
    
      
        
          
          
            application/json
          
          @{
              var allowed = new[] { __ALLOWED_MODELS__ };
              return new JObject(
                  new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                      new JProperty("type", "invalid_request_error"),
                      new JProperty("code", "model_not_allowed"),
                      new JProperty("message", "Model is missing or not allowed on this gateway. Allowed: " + string.Join(", ", allowed))
                  ))
              ).ToString();
          }
